name: 0002-guardrail-beats-merge-rule
description: A guardrail match ends evaluation before any merge rule.

rules.repo/rules/migrations-ask-me.md:
---
kind: guardrail
actions: [push, merge]
when:
  paths: ["db/migrations/**"]
then: ask
---
Changes to migrations wait for the person.
rules.repo/rules/spec-verified.md:
---
kind: merge
mode: live
require: [linked_requirement, approved_checks_pass, no_test_edits, gate_green, pipeline_green, ai_review_not_blocking, up_to_date]
max_changed_lines: 600
paths_not: [".gitlab-ci.yml"]
then: proceed
---
Spec work merges on its own when the approved checks prove it.
